judged_text: One malformed feed item permanently wedges the hourly feed import — rss.items.each calls TopicEmbed.import with no per-item error handling and the job sets retry: false, so a single item with nil title/content, a duplicate link (unique index on embed_url causing RecordNotUnique), or any import exception aborts the loop and every subsequent hourly run crashes at the same item, silently skipping everything after it forever

adjudication.rationale: In `Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed`, the code iterates `rss.items.each` and calls `CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` and `TopicEmbed.import(...)` with no per-item `rescue`/error handling. A single bad item can raise (e.g., `i.content` being `nil` will raise `NoMethodError` on `.scrub`; `open(...)`/parsing can also raise), aborting the whole job before later items are processed. Because the scheduled job sets `sidekiq_options retry: false`, that failure won’t be retried automatically, so the hourly job can keep failing on subsequent runs until the feed/item changes.
